newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bosses see less marked staff drop - survey.
newsitem.headline: French bosses see less marked staff drop - survey.

text.p: French industrialists surveyed in January said they expected staff levels to decline in the first quarter of this year in a less marked way, the national statistics institute INSEE said.
In its latest quarterly survey, INSEE said industry chiefs had noted a further decline in staff levels in January.
"The industrialists expect a slightly less marked decline in staffing levels during the first quarter of 1997," the survey said. -- Paris Newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
